niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one universally “best” CTV agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, target audience, markets, and whether you need premium streaming inventory, programmatic scale, creative for big-screen viewing, or direct-response performance.

How to pick the best CTV agency for you
- Start with your objective: brand awareness, upper-funnel reach, mid-funnel consideration, or direct-response conversions. Agencies specialize differently.
- Inventory needs: Do you need premium publisher/streamer deals (Roku, Hulu, Peacock, Samsung), or programmatic scale across many apps and platforms?
- Measurement & attribution: Do you require MMM (marketing mix modeling), deterministic OTT measurement, or event-level conversion tracking tied to in-app or website actions?
- Creative & format: Will you need CTV-specific creative and pre-testing for big-screen UX (longer spots, interactive overlays)?
- Budget & geography: Global holding-agency teams work better for large cross-market buys; specialized independents often give more agility and lower minimums.
- Tech & transparency: Do you prefer working through DSPs/tech partners like The Trade Desk, Adobe Advertising Cloud, Amobee, or direct publisher deals?

Types of partners and examples
- Global media holding groups (full-service, premium access, scale)
  - Examples: agencies inside WPP, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Publicis (their media networks such as Mindshare/Wavemaker/MediaCom/OMD/PHD/Initiative/Starcom/etc.)
  - Best when you need cross-channel planning, premium streaming deals, and global reach.
- Independent media & performance agencies (agile, performance-oriented)
  - Examples often include Tinuiti, 3Q Digital, Horizon Media (independent US-based), and other digital-first shops.
  - Best for direct-response CTV, rapid testing and optimization, and smaller budgets.
- CTV/streaming specialists and ad-tech partners
  - Platforms/tech that agencies commonly use: The Trade Desk (DSP), Adobe Advertising Cloud, Amobee; publishers like Roku, Samsung Ads, Hulu, Pluto, Peacock for direct buys.
  - Useful when you want deep programmatic expertise or direct platform partnerships.

Questions I need to recommend 3 best-fit agencies for you
- What is your primary objective (brand awareness, leads/sales, app installs)?
- Monthly or total campaign budget?
- Covered geography (US only, North America, EMEA, APAC, global)?
- Vertical (DTC, CPG, finance, gaming, entertainment, B2B)?
- Do you already use any DSPs or have existing publisher relationships?
- Do you need creative production for CTV?

If you share those details I’ll shortlist 3 agencies (or agency + platform combos) that are a strong match and provide suggested RFP/interview questions and expected fees.
